method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: a vertical flagpole passes through the top of a sandcastle; the pole’s top is marked 16 m above the floor and the pole’s bottom is marked 6 m above the floor, while the unknown height is from the floor to the sandcastle’s highest point where the pole emerges. From the text, use that exactly half of the flagpole is inserted into the sandcastle, so the sandcastle top is halfway along the flagpole between its lowest and highest ends. Compute the pole length as 16 - 6 = 10 m, so half is 5 m. Add this half-length to the pole’s bottom height: 6 + 5 = 11 m. Therefore the sandcastle is 11 m high.
